_comment: Manual picks. Priority: names (here) > akurasu.net (akurasu_terms.json) > same name in a higher section > owner group. Reasons in docs/glossary_decisions.md.

冥府の王、その名は『天』.en: The King of Hades, His Name Is "Heaven"
冥府の王、その名は『天』.reason: Expand the existing King of Hades label. Akurasu Dynasty misreads the underworld reference.

狙われたラ・ムーの星.en: The Star of La Mu, Targeted
狙われたラ・ムーの星.reason: Keep the existing source-faithful Targeted label; the source does not say Stolen.

ゼオライマー、暁に出撃す.reason: The actual Portable bitmap names Zeorymer; Akurasu lists a different title naming Hades.

Giganos Soldier.reason: Avoid overlap with Lv; full database/dialogue name retained.

Assist weapon marker.reason: Native formatter buffer holds one encoded character and NUL; As overflowed.

Solid weapon marker.reason: Translate physical/solid flag in original compact cell; B beam marker preserved.

user_spelling_0_4_14.reason: Explicit user correction on 2026-10-07 takes precedence over Akurasu joined surname.

1744.reason: Compact English translation of both title clauses; requested translation rather than romanization and must fit a single 427px music row.

1745.en: A Serene Mind, A Blazing Palm
1745.reason: Compact English translation of both title clauses; requested translation rather than romanization and must fit a single 427px music row.

albero_surname_reason: User explicitly requested Albero Est on 2026-10-07. MX term tables have no Albero entry; retain the requested spelling over the Esto variant in character reference pages.
black_selena_reason: User explicitly requested Black Selena on 2026-10-07. Overrides the refreshed Akurasu MX Mech List Sarana spelling, and the Sarena variant in older inputs, consistently for both forms and associated text.

doctor_title_context_2026_10_09.name: Genzo Umon
doctor_title_context_2026_10_09.reason: The full character name remains Genzo Umon. Dialogue that uses only the doctor title and surname should say Dr. Umon; treating this title as a misspelling produced unnatural full-name addresses. This is a context-sensitive form, not a canonical-name override.

folia_surname_reason: Extend the user-requested Albero Est surname to his son Folia Est for consistency within the same family. The refreshed Akurasu MX character table has no Folia entry; this is an explicit documented project spelling choice.

screenshot_terms_0_4_21.bryst: Explicit user correction 2026-10-10 overrides Akurasu MX Mech List Briest; retain the established of the Fires epithet.
screenshot_terms_0_4_21.mu: Explicit user correction 2026-10-10: RahXephon faction Mu, with the article the in running text, rather than the uppercase acronym MU.

hau_dragon_display.reason: User screenshot follow-up: use Hau Dragon consistently for the organization; the older Tekkoryu spelling and unspoken Iron Dragon gloss are not the ordinary display name.
hau_dragon_display.source: Explicit user request; Akurasu MX term tables have no organization entry.
hau_dragon_display.explicit_alias_exception: Only lines explicitly naming/contrasting both readings retain the literal Iron Dragon alias.

est_surname_policy.reason: 2026-10-11 user correction: use Est for both Albero and Folia in every current game-facing input.
est_surname_policy.provenance: Explicit user choice; overrides the reference-page variant surname.

squad_name_default.reason: Explicit user request: Magnet X is the default squad name. Eight characters including the space fit the native name limit.
squad_name_default.dialogue_policy: Keep #部隊名 substitution so user-selected names appear naturally in dialogue.
squad_name_default.existing_saves: Preserve saved names; Reset selects the new default.
